value.name: Asha asks about Claire's children
value.description: Asha abruptly shifts the conversation by asking Claire how many children she has.
evidence: Asha said, in the same even register she used for opposing counsel, "How many children do you have?"

value.name: Claire is startled by the question
value.description: Claire reacts with visible hesitation and a caught breath, showing the question has unsettled her.
evidence: The question landed differently than the deposit question had; Asha could hear it in the small, audible startle on the other end, the chair leg shifting again, the way Claire's next breath went in and stayed in.

value.name: Asha refuses to soften the question
value.description: Asha decides not to retract or soften her question because she needs to understand the household Marcus has been living in.
evidence: Asha did not soften it or take it back, because she understood now that the answer was the shape of the household Marcus had been lying inside, and she needed to know how many people were standing in the room she was about to walk into.

value.name: Rosa stops prompting and yields control
value.description: Far away, Rosa checks her last text and then puts her phone face-down, deciding to stop pushing and let Asha handle the conversation.
evidence: Two hundred miles away, Rosa thumbed the timestamp on her last text, then set the phone face-down on the table with a sharp click that did not carry through the line but settled something on her end anyway, a decision to stop nudging and let Asha hold the room she had built.

value.name: Claire reveals she has three children
value.description: After a tense pause, Claire answers that she has three children.
evidence: into that thinner quiet Claire said, "Three,"

value.name: Claire reveals her youngest is four months old
value.description: Claire adds that her youngest child is only four months old, deepening the significance of the family she has just disclosed.
evidence: and then, before Asha could decide what to do with it, "the youngest is four months."

value.name: Asha processes the answer silently
value.description: Asha does not respond immediately and instead registers the information with careful attention.
evidence: Asha did not answer right away; she registered the figure the way she registered a num
